headline: Philippines Observes Ninoy Aquino Day on August 21 as Three-Day Weekend Begins
seoTitle: Ninoy Aquino Day: August 21 Holiday & Pay Rules | FMB News
seoDescription: The Philippines observes Ninoy Aquino Day on Friday, August 21, 2026, a special non-working day that begins a three-day weekend.
deck: August 21 is a nationwide special non-working day under the official 2026 holiday calendar, falling on a Friday this year.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippines observes Ninoy Aquino Day on Friday, August 21, 2026, a nationwide special non-working day commemorating the death anniversary of former senator Benigno 'Ninoy' Aquino Jr.
Presidential Proclamation No. 1006 lists August 21, 2026 as a special non-working day. Because it falls on a Friday, it creates a three-day weekend through Sunday, August 23.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Republic Act No. 9256 established August 21 as Ninoy Aquino Day. Aquino was assassinated on August 21, 1983 at the then-Manila International Airport, making 2026 the 43rd anniversary of his death.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The holiday affects workplace schedules, government and business operations, travel and employee compensation. Employers and workers should follow the applicable Department of Labor and Employment rules for special non-working days.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Travelers should check operating schedules for banks, government offices, transport services and private establishments during the long weekend.
